findings.description: Direct review of the current V163 previews confirms T-pose and arms-up poses render distinctly, but the sleeve-like garment surfaces still hang away from the posed arms in T-pose and remain displaced in arms-up and arm-cross. Clearing the baked action and resetting the pose did not resolve the sleeve/body mismatch.

The neutral overskirt is irregularly collapsed and the rear shorts are broadly exposed. Sit/crouch open the front cover and expose the underlayer; prone pulls purple trim far away from the cloth. Shape and hem remain broken.

Gray patch-like areas remain visible on chest and waist, with discontinuous-looking shoulder/side surfaces. Renders cannot determine whether these are material artifacts or mesh gaps, so geometry inspection is required.

nextAction: Keep V163 rejected. The baked collider pose action was removed and the armature reset before skin/export, but current direct renders confirm sleeve/body mismatch remains. Investigate the cloth simulation stage: align body, sleeve meshes and fixed points in one rest pose before simulation, and export the settled garment and rigid trim from that same reference basis. Check T-pose and arms-up first; then repeat skirt poses only after sleeves and attachments track. Fit, collision safety, weights, complete UVs, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unverified.
